correctness.rationale: The published input is universal second-adjoint norm attainment for every endomorphism of \(\ell_1(\Lambda)\). Embedding \(R:\ell_1(\Delta)\to\ell_1(\Gamma)\) as the off-diagonal block \(A(d,g)=(0,Rd)\) preserves the norm. In the bidual \(\ell_1\)-sum, equality \(\|A^{**}(d^{**},g^{**})\|=\|R\|\) at a unit vector forces \(\|d^{**}\|=1\), so \(R^{**}\) attains its norm. For \(T:X\to Y\), isometric conjugacy of \(T^*:Y^*\to X^*\) and bidual functoriality then transfer norm attainment to \(T^{***}:Y^{***}\to X^{***}\). Zero and finite-index cases were checked separately.
